description: Deliver as a GitHub pull request per repository.

rules: body explains why, references the ticket

review.fetch: gh pr view {pr} --repo {repo} --json reviews,comments,headRefOid && gh api repos/{repo}/pulls/{pr}/comments
review.instructions: Run `sdlc review-fetch --ticket <id> --repo <repo>`: it exports reviews and line comments (with commit ids) and starts the review round.

steps: sdlc ship-request --ticket <id> --repo <repo>  (show the full request to the user)
sdlc ship --ticket <id> --repo <repo> --approve <requestDigest>  (only after the user approves that exact request)
ship.note: kaneki-ship stages exactly the reviewed files, commits as git.user, pushes with git.sshCommand and opens the PR with `gh` (check `gh auth status` shows the project's account).

steps: after the review round reaches deliverable-ready again: ship-request, approval, ship (same branch; the push updates the open PR)
